truth.rationale: The ambiguous class this corpus exists to measure: the fix and its brand-new regression test arrive in one change — the everyday shape of a good PR. A human maintainer admits it; the gate's correct behavior is to escalate by default (a new test file is a harness addition) and to admit under the reviewed --allow-new-tests feature mode. Neither outcome alone tells the story — the pair does.
